description: Represents a scheduled export of an organization's data to a destination it owns. A Data Sink is created in an organization namespace and selects the datasets to export; an organization can have several. Creating a Data Sink exports from then on: export earlier data with a backfill. Only administrators can configure Data Sinks.

ID.description: ID is the identifier of the object.
ID.title: ID

accessLogs.description: Selects the access logs dataset: roundtrips of the organization's employees. Present means selected.
accessLogs.title: accessLogs

agenticLogs.description: Selects the agentic logs dataset: roundtrips of the organization's projects (applications and their agents). Present means selected.
agenticLogs.title: agenticLogs

cadence.description: How often new data is exported.
cadence.title: cadence

description.description: The description of the data sink.
description.title: description

importHash.description: The hash of the structure used to compare with new import version.
importHash.title: importHash

importLabel.description: The user-defined import label that allows the system to group resources from the same import operation.
importLabel.title: importLabel

name.description: The internal reference name of the object. It is a sanitized version of Friendly Name if empty.
name.title: name

notifications.description: The shared alert definition created with the data sink for failing exports and the Error state. It defaults to Warning with a one-hour cooldown. No notification sink is created automatically in this version. Server owned. Attach notification sinks to the alert definition and edit it to change recipients, destinations, messages or cooldowns.
notifications.title: notifications

revision.description: Increments on each change of an export setting: cadence, dataset selection and filters, destination type and settings, including credentials.
revision.title: revision

s3.description: The configuration of the Amazon S3 destination.
s3.title: s3

state.description: The state of the data sink. Set Active or Paused. The system sets Error when exports keep failing; set Active again once the cause is fixed.
state.title: state

stateReason.description: Why the data sink is in its current state, when the system set it.
stateReason.title: stateReason

updateTime.description: Last update date of the object.
updateTime.title: updateTime

title: DataSink
